(async () => { const s = await import('/@fs/__REPO__/src/renderer/state/index.ts'); const inst = s.useSessionStore.getState().activeInstance; const l = s.useLandStore.getState(); const c = document.querySelector('canvas'); return JSON.stringify({screen: s.useSessionStore.getState().screen, look: s.useEngineStore.getState().landLook, canvas: c && {label: c.getAttribute('aria-label'), w: c.width, h: c.height}, seed: inst && inst.instance.save.seed, cartridge: inst && inst.cartridge.manifest.cartridgeId + '@' + inst.cartridge.manifest.version, scene: s.useWorldStore.getState().scene.status === 'ready' ? s.useWorldStore.getState().scene.value.contract?.sceneId : null, landMode: l.mode, chunk: s.useEngineStore.getState().chunk}); })()

new Promise((resolve) => { const open = indexedDB.open('unmapped-browser'); open.onsuccess = () => { const db = open.result; const tx = db.transaction(['blobs', 'entries', 'outbox'], 'readonly'); const out = {}; const b = tx.objectStore('blobs').getAll(); b.onsuccess = () => { out.blobs = b.result.map((r) => [r.hash, r.bytes.byteLength ?? r.bytes.length]); }; const e = tx.objectStore('entries').count(); e.onsuccess = () => { out.entries = e.result; }; const o = tx.objectStore('outbox').getAll(); o.onsuccess = () => { out.outbox = o.result.map((r) => r.events.length); }; tx.oncomplete = () => resolve(JSON.stringify(out)); }; open.onerror = () => resolve('no db'); })
